answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the pigment until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lagoon of the next round.
